positions.title: Project Information Manager
positions.description:
Assisted lead PIM with the technology requirements of a project and administered users access to project folders using active directory groups.  Support project users computer and technology related issues on a day-to-day basis.

Was involved in implementing and supporting electronic squad checking on projects using Adobe technology.

Developed job bulletins and project documentation related to automation tools.

positions.title: Project Automation Specialist
positions.description:
Created a file download application in Java using OOP paradigm and utilizing the MVC design pattern.  It used ODBC drivers to connect and extract BLOB files stored in an Oracle database and provided a GUI interface.  The utilization of this application helped projects reduce the amount of time it took to turnover thousands of documents to clients.

Created an interactive user request form in Excel driven by VBA macros to request access to the companies Document Management System (DMS).  The form was designed to guide a user through filling the form correctly by providing error checks and conditional statements.  The design and use of the form helped eliminate common errors when requesting user access to the system.

Designed web based eForm workflows for business work processes using Skelta workflow designer and Microsoft InfoPath.  This was a global initiative to help streamline common project work processes such as overtime requests and request for information (RFI) from workers at site.

Used TOAD on a daily basis to view and troubleshoot data errors in company DMS.  Also used TOAD to test and develop SQL queries from an Oracle database that would be utilized for running reports in the companies DMS.	

Was heavily involved in the coordination, organization, testing and representation of the business and user communities during the 2008/09 Projects OnLine (POL) upgrade/migration project.  This project entailed the migration of projects from the companies old DMS to the new DMS.  I Developed training material, documentation and performed training sessions for users on the new system. 

Participated on the global support team, which involved supporting and improving the daily activities of Application Specialists and DMS users.

positions.title: Knowledge Manager
positions.description:
Managed the knowledge content for two communities within Fluor’s internal knowledge management system.  Handled the creation and submission of new knowledge entries in the Project Automation & Next Generation communities.

Developed and re-designed the homepages of two communities, Project Automation & Next Generation.  Used Photoshop CS5 to design and developed the final pages in HTML, CSS and jQuery.  The homepages organized relevant knowledge topics and kept users informed of the latest news in the community.

Worked directly with the Project Automation Director/Global Excellence Leader to help coordinate global meetings and other global initiatives with various stakeholders in the company.

Currently involved in testing an in-house web application to help improve the on boarding and off boarding of users on a project.  Installed and configured the web application on a Windows 2003 test server.
